reason: A Feishu/Lark bridge that lets users chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent, manage sessions, and optionally approve bash tool calls through Feishu cards.

summaries.zh: 将飞书或 Lark 聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持会话管理、用户配对以及可选的 bash 操作审批。
summaries.en: Connects Feishu or Lark chats to a DeepSeek Harness agent with session management, user pairing, and optional approval of bash operations.

capabilities: Receives and sends Feishu or Lark chat messages
Invokes DeepSeek Harness agent turns through its Python SDK
Maintains chat sessions and pairing or allowlist state
Can request and execute bash tool calls when approval mode is enabled
Uses configured API credentials and external service credentials
